name: Maury Lie Detector
look: TV host Maury Povich, gray-haired with glasses, sits in a beige chair in front of a brick wall, wearing a black sweater over a gray collared shirt, and reads results from a card printed with the Maury show logo.
use: Exposes an obvious lie. The top caption quotes a claim someone made, and the bottom delivers Maury's verdict, usually 'The lie detector determined that was a lie.'
slots: top caption: the claim someone made
bottom caption: 'The lie detector determined that was a lie'
examples: The lie detector determined that was a lie
'I have read and agree to the terms and conditions'
The lie detector determined that was a lie
describe: talk show host reading lie detector results from a card
old man with glasses reading test results on his tv show
maury povich sitting in a chair holding a card
gray haired host in a black sweater revealing the results
daytime tv host reading a card that says maury
origin: From the daytime talk show Maury, where host Maury Povich reads lie detector and paternity test results to his guests.
